name: EU Blue Card (Tarjeta Azul-UE)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an employment contract of at least 6 months (or indefinite) with a Spanish employer.
This requires a higher-education qualification, or at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain formal recognition of your degree if issued abroad, or document qualifying experience.

value.note: 1.4x the INE average gross annual earnings per worker; re-indexed June 2026

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a gross annual salary of at least €41,356.36 (2026 figure, in force since June 2026).
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a higher salary, or check eligibility for the reduced threshold.

requirement_groups.name: Reduced threshold — shortage occupation or recent graduate

requirements.blocker_text: This reduced threshold applies to CNO-2011 group 1-2 occupations that also appear on the shortage catalogue, or to applicants who obtained their qualification within the last 3 years.
This requires a gross annual salary of at least €33,085.09 (80% of the standard 2026 threshold).

evidence_required.document: Degree certificate or documented 5+ years' professional experience
Employment contract meeting the applicable salary threshold

sources.title: BOE — Orden PJC/44/2026, de 27 de enero, EU Blue Card threshold methodology
Ministerio de Inclusión, Seguridad Social y Migraciones — UGE-CE umbral salarial, June 2026 update

notes: Same threshold and same June-2026 re-indexing as es_work_cuenta_ajena's PAC group (€41,356.36 / €33,085.09) — Spain's Blue Card and Highly Qualified Professional category share the identical salary figure, a genuine structural simplification worth noting, unlike Germany and the Netherlands where Blue Card and the general skilled-worker route have distinct thresholds. Processed by UGE-CE with full EU portability and time in other EU states counting toward the Spanish settlement clock — standard Blue Card mobility rights, consistent with Germany's and the Netherlands' versions. HIGH STALE-DATA RISK, same as flagged on es_work_cuenta_ajena: the January 2026 figure (€39,269.92) is superseded; any source citing that number is stale as of June 2026.
